name: Kuze Takahiro
source:
The story's protagonist. He grew up with a loving father and mother until a "terrible incident" happened. Although the incident caused some ripples on his psyche, he is fair and kind at heart. At his age, he is the manager of the Quality Control Department, where prospective executives are supposed to be assigned.

[Translated from the [url=http://pro-page.jp/fpp/uuudiary-disk/character.html]Official Website[/url]]
